issue_context.title: QUIC: update status codes for unix platforms
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/microsoft/msquic/pull/1645 changed error codes for platforms other than Windows. 
While the goal seems to be better alignment with posix e.g. all the codes map to errno values, the actual values differ (and had in the past) among platforms. 
For example the `EOVERFLOW` is 75 on Linux but 84 on macOS. 

We should probably ether re-factor current code to have real PAL files and include one per platform instead of 
```c#
internal static uint Pending => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? Windows.Pending : Posix.Pending;
```

or we should map msquic codes to portable .NET enum.
